meta.title: Pricing Plans for Shopify Bulk Ordering
meta.description: Simple pricing plans for every Shopify store. Start free with the Starter plan and scale with Standard or Professional as your bulk ordering grows.

hero.title: Simple Pricing for Every Shopify Store

features.title: Custom Out-of-Stock Badge

features.title: Flexible Variant Display

features.title: Sticky Add to Cart Button

features.title: Global Cart Restriction

items.q: Do you offer a free plan?
items.a: Yes. The Starter plan is free forever and includes core variant display features, so you can start using MultiVariants at no cost.

items.q: Do you offer a free trial?
items.a: Yes. Paid plans include a 14-day free trial so you can evaluate fit before committing.

items.q: Can I upgrade or downgrade my plan?
items.a: Absolutely. You can switch plans anytime based on your store's ordering volume and requirements.

items.q: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
items.a: Yes. You can cancel at any time from your Shopify app billing settings.

items.q: Will uninstalling the app affect my theme?
items.a: No permanent theme damage is made. We follow safe integration patterns and can help with cleanup if needed.
